dataset.name: Momentum: 2009 crash
dataset.caption: Kenneth French's daily momentum factor (long last year's winners, short last year's losers). Window: the 750 trading days ending 2009-12-31 (2007-01-11 to 2009-12-31); the first 250 (to 2008-01-08) are the warm-up the tool learns 'normal' from. Why this window: the 2009 momentum crash is the textbook 'broken or bad run?' case. Same rule for every real dataset. Thresholds were tuned on strategies simulated from the warm-up fit, never on these returns. Source: Kenneth R. French Data Library.
